title: Collatz Covering Claim in Lean 4: Type-Checked Formal Specification of the Open 2-Adic Cylinder Covering Conjecture
description: Standalone Lean 4 formalization (`CoveringClaim.lean`, `CoveringClaim/Claim.lean`, `CoveringClaim/Defs.lean`) giving a clean, type-checked formal specification of the open Collatz covering claim over residue classes modulo powers of two. Formalizes the exact mathematical statement of the open Collatz covering claim in Lean 4 without claiming a proof of the Collatz conjecture. Copyright (c) 2026 Benjamin Stanley Frohman.
